start.npc: {npc_name} wipes soot from their knuckles. "If you need a blade sung back into shape, you came to the right fire. If you need charity, keep walking."

options.text: I respect good work. Your forge looks well kept.
Need materials or dangerous work handled?
About that work you gave me...

craft_pride.npc: "It stays kept because I do not let fools touch it. Still, you have an eye for honest work. I'd open my shop menu if I had one, but alas..."

options.text: Then maybe you could give me a quest instead you lumpy sack of potatoes.

smith_quest.npc: "Aye. {quest_description} Bring it done, and I will pay proper."

turn_in.npc: "You're back. Tell me you have progress on {quest_label}."

options.text: Not yet. I wanted to check in.

complete.npc: "You kept your word. Good iron respects a steady hand, and so do I. Take what I promised."

not_done.npc: "Then do not let the work cool. {quest_description}"

accepted.npc: "Good. Come back when {quest_label} is finished. I do not pay for promises."

declined.npc: "Then do not stand in the heat pretending you want work."

insult.npc: "Say that again and I will show you how weak iron feels against bone."
